error_text:
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
context: Push/pull over SSH fails with a key error.
root_cause: No SSH key is offered, or the key is not added to the account.
fix: Generate a key (`ssh-keygen`), add the public key to the hosting account, and test with `ssh -T git@host`.
title: Permission denied (publickey).
